messages:
Maya: @channel seeing intermittent failures in nightly evals for the translation prompt set. ~10% of runs time out in the harness. Started after deploy on Thu (commit abc1234). Adding logs now but wanted to flag.

Sam: which timeout? harness overall or per-case? any stack trace?

Maya: harness marks as 'worker timed out' with last lines:
```
[2026-02-12 03:12:45,678] ERROR runner - test translation_prompt_set - timed out after 60s waiting for response
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File /opt/harness/run.py, line 412, in _exec_case
    fut.result()
concurrent.futures._base.CancelledError
```
Happens across different VMs; reproduces rarely locally.

Eli: didn't we change our ThreadPoolExecutor default in infra-lib in abc1234? I bumped max_workers from a small constant to None so it now uses os.cpu_count()*5; could be too many threads causing scheduling/race with the async event loop.

Victoria: CI bot shows similar failures in job nightly-evals/2026-02-12-03. Posting link: https://ci/internal/job/1234

CI Bot: job nightly-evals/2026-02-12-03 failed: 3 tests timed out (translation_prompt_set x2, reranking_prompt_set x1). Artifacts: /artifacts/1789012345/logs.tar.gz

Sam: can we bisect in time? run the harness against master from before abc1234 and after. I'll kick off a bisection script.

Maya: running quick local repro with:
```bash
HARNESS_DEBUG=1 PYTHONWARNINGS=ignore pytest tests/nightly/test_translation.py -k translation_prompt_set -s --runslow
```
Ran it 20x, saw 1 timeout.

Eli: try run with `-k translation_prompt_set -n 8` (xdist) - we might amplify concurrency and hit the race.

Maya: ran xdist 6 workers for 50 iterations, reproduced twice. Stack traces point to `asyncio.get_event_loop()` errors interleaved with ThreadPoolExecutor shutdown.

Sam: hypothesis: threadpool executor is being shutdown from main thread while async tasks still reference it. Could be ordering change from abc1234 where we call `executor.shutdown(wait=False)` earlier in teardown.

Victoria: suggestion: add guard in harness teardown to wait for pending futures and add explicit `loop.run_until_complete(asyncio.sleep(0))` to flush tasks.

Eli: I can put a quick patch that defers executor.shutdown to after loop close. Patch:
```py
# in harness/runner.py
await asyncio.sleep(0)
executor.shutdown(wait=True)
```
I'll open a PR and run nightly.

Sam: also add more logging around executor._shutdown and pending futures count (len(executor._work_queue)) — ugly but useful short-term.

Maya: PR 4321 opened: https://repo/pulls/4321 - unit CI green. Kicking off patch-nightly job.

CI Bot: job patch-nightly/4321 started. Will post results.

CI Bot: job patch-nightly/4321 failed (1 timeout in translation_prompt_set). Attached logs.

Eli: hmm still flaky. Can someone grep logs for 'Event loop closed' vs 'CancelledError' counts?

Maya: counts from artifacts: CancelledError 4, Event loop closed 1.

Sam: ok plan: (1) backport extra sync and logging (2) deploy to non-prod cluster with reduced parallelism (max_workers=8) (3) re-run stressed nightly 200 iterations. If still flaky, bisect uvloop/looppolicy changes.

Victoria: I can run the 200 stress iterations on a c5-large pool tonight. Will report results in this thread.

Eli: also adding a small reproducer script that exercises the harness core loop in a tight loop to isolate ordering.

Maya: thanks. I'll keep thread updated. If Victoria reproduces consistently we'll merge. :thumbsup:

Victoria: ran 200 iterations on reduced-parallelism pool: 0 timeouts. On high-concurrency pool: 6 timeouts. Full repro correlated with high max_workers + uvloop enabled.

Sam: that strongly suggests event loop policy/uvloop interaction. Let's try forcing stdlib event loop in harness run: `UVLOOP=0` env.

Maya: ran with UVLOOP=0 xdist 12 -> 0 timeouts over 100 iterations. Looks good.

Eli: PR 4330 opened: add env override to CI nightly to disable uvloop until we have robust shutdown.

Sam: long-term: change harness to not rely on default loop policy; explicitly create and set loop per worker.

Maya: agree. For now schedule: merge 4330, backport to nightly, monitor next 3 runs. Closing this thread when green for 3 runs. Thanks all.

CI Bot: patch-nightly/4330 queued. Expected runtime ~30m.

Maya: closing when green. Bye.
